doctors.bio: Dr. Sindhu holds an MDS in Periodontics and heads the clinic. Her day-to-day work is the health of the gums and the bone that anchors each tooth: bleeding or receding gums, deep cleaning, gum surgery and the regular maintenance visits that keep gum disease from coming back. She also sees patients for routine check-ups, scaling and polishing, and cosmetic concerns. If you are not sure which specialist you need, book with her first and she will guide you.

Dr. Preethi is an MDS oral and maxillofacial surgeon. She removes teeth that cannot be saved, including impacted wisdom teeth, and carries out minor oral surgery and the surgical stage of dental implants. Before any procedure she walks you through what will happen, how long healing usually takes and what to do at home afterwards.

Dr. Naveen Kumar is an MDS endodontist — a specialist in the soft tissue inside the tooth. He treats infected or badly decayed teeth with root canal treatment so that they can stay in the mouth rather than be removed. He also re-treats earlier root canals that have become painful again and provides pulp therapy for children's milk teeth.

_note_doctorsNotInImporter: The importer does not set appointmentDurationMinutes or weekly schedules. Apply afterwards via the admin API: PUT /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId} {appointmentDurationMinutes: 15}, then POST /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId}/schedules per day (Mon–Sat 10:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00, PLACEHOLDER). No photos: initials avatars.

faqs.question: What are the clinic timings?
faqs.answer: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM. Closed on Sunday (working days to be confirmed). Working days are to be confirmed by the clinic.

faqs.question: Where exactly is the clinic?
faqs.answer: On Ashramam Road, Tadepalli, Andhra Pradesh. The exact door number and landmark will be added here soon; until then, call us for directions.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Use the Book button on any page. Choose your concern, doctor, day and time, and confirm with a one-time code sent to your mobile. You can also call the clinic.

faqs.question: Do you publish treatment prices?
faqs.answer: No. The cost depends on what the examination shows, so the dentist explains the plan and the fee before any treatment begins.

faqs.question: Which doctor should I book?
faqs.answer: If you know your problem, the booking form suggests the right specialist. If you are unsure, book a check-up with Dr. Sindhu and she will guide you.

faqs.question: Will I get a reminder before my appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Online bookings are confirmed by email, and reminders are sent before the visit.
